postSubject: While I don't watch him, I do not mind the guy. I've heard he doesn't like five nights at freddy's, and now, I know a flame war is kind of inevitable in asking this, but, why not? I mean, I would think that someone like himself, who has been doing indie horror for years now would like such a game, how can he shun such a game as five nights at freddys, when its been the only indie horror to do anything besides running around in a generic amnesia ripoff in years? He's experienced this first hand!
commentSubject: Everyone has their own likes and dislikes. I can tell that Pewdiepie doesn't like FNaF but plays it for his viewers anyway (which is cool of him).  Hopefully he will like FNaF3 better! ;)
